subject.title: fix: tighten control ui input validation [AI]

question: Should Control UI previews reject .git/.atom repository suffixes and config merge patches silently discard the four legacy accessor method keys?
rationale: Both restrictions are intentional defense-in-depth choices that can reject inputs current users could previously submit, so source inspection alone cannot establish the desired compatibility policy.
